name: Results jump in a 6-month leader
author: claude
hypothesis: A 4%+ results-day jump on 2x turnover in a stock already up 20%+ over 120 sessions (strong business momentum confirmed by results) drifts further for two weeks.
filter: days_since_result == 0 and result_ret >= {jump} and result_turn_mult >= 2 and result_close_loc >= 0.75 and ret_120 > {mom}
